atlas_description: Population-genomic inversion detection, karyotyping, and follow-up for the 226-sample pure C. gariepinus hatchery cohort.

pages.label: local PCA |z|
pages.tooltip: Local PCA on dosage. Sim_mat heatmap, robust |Z|, per-sample lines, K-means PCA, L3 contingency. THE big page.

pages.label: haplotype regimes
pages.tooltip: Long-range haplotype regimes (Stage 4 bruteforce projection). Run runBandingPipeline on the active chromosome and explore where each seed-band voter lands across target windows. Export the result as a regime catalogue JSON.

pages.label: PCA compare
pages.tooltip: Cross-evidence PCA comparator (dosage · θπ · GHSL). 3 synchronized mini-PCA panels at the active window; hover a dot to track it across all 3 axes + per-sample 3-axis trajectory + concordance badge. K-band coloring inherits from the anchor's clustering (default: dosage). Read-only inspector.

pages.label: sim_mat
pages.tooltip: Dedicated window × window similarity heatmap — the same drawSim view that local_pca_dosage shows in its sim panel, as a standalone surface. Click to jump the cursor.

pages.label: tree panel
pages.tooltip: Inversion-core sample tree (NJ on dosage distances) with cluster colouring and ARI-vs-clusters badge (HANDOFF_5).

pages.label: fingerprint track
pages.tooltip: Per-window diversity-regime fingerprint with rank-equivalence regime IDs, switch markers, fragment-proportions treemap, and architecture-scenario verdict (HANDOFF_6).

pages.label: similarity matrix
pages.tooltip: Per-window sample×sample similarity heatmap with block detection + adjacent-window ARI transition strip (HANDOFF_10).

pages.label: PCA scatter
pages.tooltip: Per-window PC1×PC2 scatter with cluster colouring and λ-magnitude scrubber (SPEC_0 §10 Phase 1).

pages.label: dosage heatmap
pages.tooltip: Sample × marker dosage heatmap with K=3 group track and polarity stripe. Accepts mgl_heatmap_json or legacy candidate-chunk shape via shared adapters (SPEC_0 §11).

pages.label: nested detector
pages.tooltip: Nested-inversion detector with 3 stratum tracks (HOM1 / HET / HOM2) and contiguous inner-interval overlays (HANDOFF_7).

pages.label: dosage cluster
pages.tooltip: Adaptive-K sample clustering on per-window dosage profiles, with per-K scoring table and cluster mean-curve display (HANDOFF_8).

pages.label: stats profile
pages.tooltip: Manuscript-bound statistical profile per candidate. Reads cross-species.synteny + runs the focal-vs-background permutation test on top of base pi/FST/dXY/HWE. Complement to popstats.popstats (which is the lightweight live group-wise tile); stats_profile is the deep, manuscript-ready surface.
pages._overlap_resolved_2026_05_23: Earlier audit flagged stats_profile as potentially duplicating popstats.popstats. Resolved 2026-05-23: keep both. popstats.popstats = live cohort tile, computes groupwise_stats_v1 on demand. stats_profile = manuscript page, layers cross-species synteny + permutation test on top + writes the manuscript-ready table. Complementary, not redundant. Do NOT consolidate.

pages.label: overview
pages.tooltip: Synthesis landing surface. Two tiles: (1) layer inventory — workspace action-pipeline envelopes queried from GET /api/layers, grouped by layer_type; (2) candidate spreadsheet — sortable + filterable table of all promoted inversion candidates with TSV export. Manuscript-bound deliverable.
pages._status_2026_05_23: Implemented in two tiles 2026-05-23. (a) Layer inventory had landed round-1 2026-05-14. (b) Candidate spreadsheet added 2026-05-23 — completes the second feature the legacy monolith comments hinted at ('candidate overview spreadsheet, manuscript-bound deliverables', monolith line 5134). Earlier annotation calling this an 'empty stub' was based on the page's outdated header comment and is no longer accurate.

pages.label: help
pages.tooltip: Quick-reference / help page (static HTML, no JS render). NB: legacy 'help' is the help page, NOT multi-species — the multi-species cockpit is multi_species_cockpit.

server._doc: Server moved to atlas-core/server/ (turn 'core-server-unify'). Every endpoint here (popstats / LD / dosage / file / compute) is generic plumbing — the inversion atlas reaches it the same way every other atlas will. See atlas-core/server/SERVER_README.md.

_stylesheets_chrome_doc: atlas_chrome.css is a generic chrome stylesheet (tab pills + settings button + active-stage folding) shipped here as a CANDIDATE FOR PROMOTION to atlas-core. Pairs with shared/atlas_chrome.js. Other atlases can drop the same two files in. When atlas-core ships its own copy, remove this entry + delete the cartridge copy.
_stylesheets_doc: Atlas-wide stylesheets, loaded by the shell at atlas-register time. Currently one big bundle (extracted verbatim from the legacy monolith). Future work: split into per-page stylesheets (atlases/inversion/css/pages/local_pca_dosage.css etc.) and reference them from each page entry's `stylesheet` field below — the router loads page-stylesheet on mount.
_scope_pickers_doc: Pickers rendered in the shell's #scopebar (sticky strip below the topbar). Each picker drives an AtlasState slot via setActiveChrom / setActiveCandidate / generic emit. `auto_options_from: <root_name>` makes the dropdown discover its options at runtime via GET /api/precomp_index?root=<root_name> — the server walks the pipeline output dir and returns whichever chromosomes have an atlas JSON on disk. No manual list to maintain; add a new chrom to the pipeline output and it shows up in the dropdown on next page load. (A static `options: [...]` array is still supported for pickers that aren't backed by a precomp root.)

stages.label: discovery
stages._doc: End-to-end discovery: |z|-based local-PCA detection, per-candidate deep-dive, haplotype regimes, cross-evidence PCA comparator, and the final-step candidate validation (boundary refinement + SV evidence). Merged from 'discovery 1' + 'discovery 2' on 2026-05-20 — the two-stage split was a legacy artifact; a single discovery stage matches the actual workflow (find → focus → refine → validate). Pages: local_pca_dosage (find), candidate_focus (focus), haplotype_regimes (regimes), pca_comparator (cross-axis check), boundary_refinement (last-step: where exactly does it start/end), sv_evidence (last-step: do SV callers agree). Per-window summary table + negative regions catalogue live in 'catalogue'. Utility / inspector cartridges (tree panel, fingerprint track, similarity matrix, PCA scatter, dosage heatmap, nested detector, dosage cluster) live in 'tooling'.

stages.label: tooling
stages._doc: Utility / inspector cartridges. Open these to characterise a candidate, debug a layer, or compare evidence axes. Distinct from discovery_2's workflow pages. Pages currently in this stage: tree_panel, fingerprint_track, similarity_matrix, pca_scatter_per_window, dosage_heatmap, nested_inversion_detector, dosage_cluster_adaptive_k (re-staged from discovery_2 on 2026-05-16 per AUDIT_local_pca_merge_vs_rename.md §Q3). Future additions: page_pca_comparator (per SPEC_local_pca_comparator.md). Atlas-core shell may render this stage as a vertical sidebar rather than horizontal pills — that's a shell-side change tracked separately.

stages.label: classification
stages._doc: Per-candidate karyotype assignment + marker readiness. Shrunk to 2 pages on 2026-05-18 (see STAGE_AUDIT_2026-05-18.md): ancestry / boundary-refinement / SV-evidence / popstats / stats_profile / overview moved out to evolution / discovery_2 / synthesis. Only karyotype_tier + marker_readiness remain — the actual per-candidate "what kind of inversion" surfaces.

stages.label: synthesis
stages._doc: Cohort-level synthesis surfaces. Project overview, manuscript-ready statistical profile, per-window popstats track stack. Restored 2026-05-18 — these pages were originally synthesis-stage in legacy but got swept into classification by the slug-migration scripts. See STAGE_AUDIT_2026-05-18.md for the audit trail.

_stages_removed_2026_05_23: Removed the 'evolution' stage entry — all pages migrated to evolution-atlas (Phase 1a). Stage orders renumbered: synthesis 6→5, help 7→6. If a future inversion-side evolution embed (e.g. archaeology_card keyed by inversion candidate) lands, recreate the stage entry.

cross_atlas._doc: In/out adapter declaration. Inversion is the central producer (inversion candidates + regimes drive every other atlas). Imports the data needed to call those candidates: cross-species breakpoints, genome assembly + annotation, popstats + evolution feedback.

imports.purpose: Canonical chrom lengths + names. Used by every inversion page that draws a chromosome axis.
Mask centromere zones out of the candidate pool (low-confidence regions).
Gene cargo per candidate; functional context on candidate_focus.
Seed coordinates for candidate calls + cross-method-validated Tier 1 anchors.
BP5 arc visualisation embedded on cross_species_breakpoints page (legacy comparative).
5-class A-E classification surfaced in the catalogue.
Cohort-level FST/dXY/pi per candidate. Read on candidate_focus + stats_profile.
Per-window CO density as a track on local_pca_dosage.
Per-chromosome diversity rollup. Inversion overlays the theta_pi component as a background track on the local-PCA scrubber.
Per-sample H baseline for the Hobs/Hexp QC chip.
Pairwise kinship for the layer_cleaning ancestry downweighting. (ngsrelate_kinship lives in population-atlas, not relatedness — corrected 2026-05-23.)
K-cluster Q-matrix for global ancestry context.

exports.purpose: The canonical inversion candidate list. Every per-candidate operation in every atlas is keyed by candidate_id.
Per-chrom local-PCA atlas JSON. Read by review/popstats.js and age_divergence for chrom-level context.
Haplotype regime catalogue (Cluster 4 of the haplotype-regimes pipeline). Relatedness reads it for regime-inheritance; popstats reads it for per-regime stats.
Per-candidate version-index. Required arg for all per-candidate cross-atlas reads.
